server.source: ServerHello + minisign verification against repo-pinned key

notes: CancelCast is the engine-advertised analog of the reported 'click outside the dialog' dismiss (OptionalCostModal maps outside dismissal to CancelCast; ManaPaymentUI dispatches it).
Exploit 1+2: pay buyback, tap one Llanowar Elves for convoke, then CancelCast at ManaPayment.
Variant: CancelCast directly at the buyback OptionalCostChoice.
Control: full cast through resolution (buyback paid, convoke tap, auto-pay rest) creates exactly one Saproling and returns Sprout Swarm to hand.
Dense playsets are a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games).
limitations: Authoritative exports are point-in-time snapshots; the cancel itself is observed via wire_log.jsonl event sequence (convoke_tap -> CancelCast -> Priority, no token, swarm back in hand).
